patches.reason: Keep art-room painting server-authoritative: accept only canvases from the server-built canvas inventory, only Vector3 positions and Paint/Erase modes, require BrickColor for painting, require the requesting player to be in the Art zone, and reject malformed paintbrush state requests.

replacements.old:
module.SetCanvases()

game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.PlacePaintRequest.OnServerInvoke = function(plr, canvas, position, mode, brickcolor)
	return module.PlacePaint(plr, canvas, position, mode, brickcolor)
end
replacements.new:
module.SetCanvases()

local function isKnownCanvas(canvas)
	if typeof(canvas) ~= "Instance" then
		return false
	end
	for _,knowncanvas in pairs(module.canvases) do
		if knowncanvas == canvas then
			local owner = canvas:FindFirstChild("CanvasOwner")
			return owner ~= nil and owner:IsA("ObjectValue")
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function playerIsInArtZone(plr)
	return game.ServerStorage.RemoteFunctions.PlayerIsInZone:Invoke(plr, "Art") == true
end

game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.PlacePaintRequest.OnServerInvoke = function(plr, canvas, position, mode, brickcolor)
	if not playerIsInArtZone(plr) then
		return false
	end
	if not isKnownCanvas(canvas) or typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then
		return false
	end
	if mode ~= "Paint" and mode ~= "Erase" then
		return false
	end
	if mode == "Paint" and typeof(brickcolor) ~= "BrickColor" then
		return false
	end
	return module.PlacePaint(plr, canvas, position, mode, brickcolor)
end

patches.reason: Preserve the existing Roblox privacy and per-recipient text filtering while enforcing the client UI's 160-character limit on the server, validating Player targets and texting state, bounding message request frequency, and rejecting malformed block-toggle targets.

replacements.new:
game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.SendTextMessage.OnServerInvoke = function(plr,targetplr,thread,input)
	if typeof(targetplr) ~= "Instance" or not targetplr:IsA("Player") or targetplr.Parent ~= game.Players or targetplr == plr then
		return false,"Error: Player not found"
	end
	if type(input) ~= "string" or #input < 1 or #input > 160 then
		return false,"Error: Invalid message"
	end
	local textingdata = plr:FindFirstChild("textingdata")
	if not textingdata or not textingdata:FindFirstChild("messages") or not textingdata:FindFirstChild("blocklist") then
		return false,"Error: Messaging not ready"
	end
	local now = tick()
	local lastrequest = textrequesttime[plr]
	if lastrequest and now - lastrequest < .25 then
		return false,"Error: Please wait"
	end
	textrequesttime[plr] = now
